module_summary: Two-state Moore FSM: a 1-bit state register, async reset to B, toggles on in=0 and drives out high in state B.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Two-state register A/B, async reset to B, next state chosen by in.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Moore output decoded high when FSM is in state B.

groups.name: fsm
groups.description: State register, in-driven next-state logic and output decode.
